children: Isprava Group has appointed Dr Sanjay Sethi as strategic advisor, bringing more than 37 years of experience across hospitality operations, development, ownership, strategic growth and capital markets. Sethi will work with the Group across Lohono Stays and Isprava Hospitality, advising on strategy, growth and the development of its hospitality business.

The appointment comes as Isprava Group builds an integrated ecosystem spanning luxury homes, hospitality, private membership and end-to-end homeowner services. Sethi’s owner-operator perspective will bring a hospitality lens to the Group as it develops greater consistency and connection across its businesses.

“For us, the opportunity is to think beyond individual businesses and create an ecosystem where every interaction adds to the experience of being part of Isprava. Whether someone is staying at a Lohono home, spending time at Solene or returning to their own Isprava home, we want every touchpoint to feel more considered, more seamless and more distinctly ours.

Sanjay’s understanding of hospitality, combined with his experience of building businesses at scale, will help us bring greater depth and consistency to that experience as we grow. We’re looking forward to having him work with us as we build this next phase of the business.” said Nibhrant Shah, managing director and co-CEO, Isprava Group.

Sethi spent 14 years with the Taj Group before co-founding Keys Hotels & Resorts, backed by Berggruen Holdings. From 2015 to 2026, he served as managing director and CEO of Chalet Hotels Limited, taking the company through its 2019 IPO and building it into an owner-developer of luxury and upper-upscale hotels. He continues to serve on the Chalet board as a non-executive director.
